pageTitle: New York Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: What are the requirements to buy lottery tickets in New York?
items.answer:
To play in the New York State Lottery, you need to be 18 years or older. Besides buying tickets at authorized retailers, you can also purchase lottery tickets online for Mega Millions, Cash4Life, and New York Lotto. However, keep in mind that telephone and mail purchases are prohibited.

The New York Lottery also allows players to buy tickets for multiple draws in advance. You can purchase up to 14 draws for Numbers Midday, Numbers Evening, Win 4 Midday, and Win 4 Evening. Additionally, seven advanced draws are available for Take 5 and Pick 10, while New York Lotto, Powerball, Mega Millions, and Cash4Life allow you to buy as many as 28 advanced picks.

items.question: What lottery games can you play in New York?
items.answer:
Although you won’t find the New York Lottery Lucky for Life game, you can choose from ten other lotteries. The rewards for each game vary, with some offering a top prize and others featuring a jackpot.

 

Let’s examine each game and its New York Lottery numbers:

 

Numbers Midday – Pick three numbers between 0-9

Numbers Evening – Pick three numbers between 0-9

Win 4 Midday – Pick four numbers between 0-9

Win 4 Evening – Pick four numbers between 0-9

Take 5 – Pick five numbers between 1-39

Pick 10 – Pick ten numbers between 1-80

New York Lotto – Pick six numbers between 1-59

Powerball – Pick five numbers between 1-69 and an extra number between 1-26

Mega Millions – Pick five numbers between 1-70 and an extra number between 1-25

Cash4Life – Pick five numbers between 1-60

items.question: Where and how do you claim winnings from the New York Lottery?
items.answer:
Like many state lotteries, New York provides winners with two options: a single lump sum or an annuity payment that spans 26 years. After the compulsory press event that highlights the lucky participants, you can expect to receive your winnings within a minimum of three days.

 

If you win $600 or less, you can claim your prize money at a licensed retail location, or any New York Lottery Customer Service Centers:

 

Buffalo Claim Center

Fishkill Claim Center

Long Island Claim Center

Schenectady Claim Center

Syracuse Claim Center

Resorts World Casino Claim Center

Empire City Casino Yonkers Raceway Claim Center

Saratoga Casino Hotel Claim Center

Finger Lakes Gaming & Racetrack Claim Center

Hamburg Gaming Claim Center

Tioga Downs Casino Claim Center

Vernon Downs Casino & Hotel Claim Center

Batavia Downs Gaming Claim Center

Jake’s 58 Claim Center

Additionally, all prizes worth $601 or more must be claimed at a New York Lottery Customer Service Center. The other option is to complete a claim form and send it via mail. However, if you choose the latter, make sure you use registered mail; otherwise, you’ll go through endless hassles if your ticket gets lost.

items.question: How do you play and win in the New York lottery?
items.answer:
All games in the New York Lottery use a specific range of numbers. To win, you need to choose the same numbers that you think will appear in the draw. For example, Take 5 includes all numbers between 1-39, which means that you need to select five figures in this range on your ticket.

Then, if the draw picks the same five New York Lottery winning numbers, you’ll walk away with the jackpot prize. However, remember that if someone else also wins, the jackpot will be shared between all the winners.

items.question: What time the New York Lottery results draw?
items.answer:
You can check the results of the New York Lottery games as follows:

 

Numbers Midday draws take place every day at 12:20 pm

Numbers Evening draws take place every day at 7:30 pm

Win 4 Midday draws take place every day at 12:20 pm

Win 4 Evening draws take place every day at 7:30 pm

Take 5 draws take place every day at 11:21 pm

Pick 10 draws take place every day at 8:30 pm

New York Lotto draws take place on Wednesdays and Saturdays at 11:21 pm

New York Lottery Powerball draws take place on Wednesdays and Saturdays at 10:59 pm

New York Lottery Mega Millions draws take place on Tuesdays and Fridays at 11:00 pm

Cash4Life draws take place every day at 9:00 pm

items.question: What is the New York Lottery second chance?
items.answer:
The New York Lottery app offers you extra winning opportunities in the form of Collect ‘N Win and Extended Play.

Once you download the app, enter your ticket details (provided it’s not a winner), or use the New York Lottery ticket scanner to have a second chance at instant wins, play New York Lottery scratch games, and receive promotions. Furthermore, you can access New York Lottery codes and check the lottery results instantly.

items.question: Do you have to pay tax on New York Lottery winnings?
items.answer:
Yes. The state withholds taxes for US citizens as follows:

 

State tax: 8.82%

Federal tax: 24%

Total: 32.82%

Furthermore, if you reside in Yonkers, you’re taxed an additional 1.477%, resulting in a total of 34.297%.
